# KASANE

> KASANE is an independent editorial atlas of living culture: 24 places in 22 countries, read through architecture, culture, landscape, food and the calendar.

## What this site is

KASANE is a static editorial publication and a browser-based travel planner. It does not take bookings, sell trips or publish rankings. Places are described editorially; event dates are checked against official sources and should be confirmed with the organiser.

## Main sections

- [The atlas](https://kasane-atlas.pages.dev/explore): search and filter every destination.
- [Journal](https://kasane-atlas.pages.dev/journal): essays on places, architecture, culture and nature.
- [Culture](https://kasane-atlas.pages.dev/culture): beliefs, rituals, food, craft and local life.
- [Events](https://kasane-atlas.pages.dev/events): a checked calendar of cultural festivals and gatherings.
- [Collections](https://kasane-atlas.pages.dev/collections): curated routes through the atlas.
- [Plan a journey](https://kasane-atlas.pages.dev/plan): a local, day-by-day itinerary tool.
- [About](https://kasane-atlas.pages.dev/about): what KASANE is and how it is made.
